name: chat-board
description: A pane with the latest messages of one chat channel, read from the local chat log, refreshed every few seconds, and a channel list to browse the channels on this machine.

enabled.title: Chat board
enabled.description: Register the chat-board command, its pane and its agent tool. Off removes them.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: The channel to show, with its #. Empty shows #ops.
